title: No. She didn’t want anything
html_source: Like with the cat, Mr Bloom can interpret nonverbal communication and understand what she wants.

anchor.prefix:
—I'm going round the corner. Be back in a minute.

And when he had heard his voice say it he added:

—You don't want anything for breakfast?

A sleepy soft grunt answered:

—Mn.
anchor.suffix: . He heard then a warm heavy sigh, softer, as she turned over and the loose brass quoits of the bedstead jingled. Must get those settled really. Pity. All the way from Gibraltar. F
